title: Proper-support direct image preserves bounded coherent complexes
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and f:X\to S a morphism locally of finite type. If E is bounded with coherent cohomology on X [def-pc-derived-category] and every cohomology sheaf of E has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then Rf_*E [def-pc-derived-direct-image] has bounded coherent cohomology on S.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2; label lemma-direct-image-coherent)

proof.text: Represent E by a bounded complex K of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] with $v=f_*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_S)$, a left exact additive functor between Grothendieck abelian categories (Stacks 077K), so that $Rv(K)=Rf_*E$. It gives the convergent spectral sequence $E_2^{p,q}=R^pf_*H^q(E)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(Rf_*E)$, with $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\ge0$ and $q\ge a$ (where $H^q(E)=0$ for $q<a$), and finite filtrations on the abutment cohomology sheaves whose graded pieces are the $E_\infty^{p,q}$ (parts 2, 3, 5 and 6 of [thm-sp-truncation-e2]).

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof

proof.text: For every q, H^q(E) is coherent and its support is proper over S by the hypotheses. Therefore [lem-pc-coherent-support-proper-higher-direct-image] makes every E_2^{p,q}=R^p f_*H^q(E) coherent.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof

proof.text: Because E is bounded, only finitely many rows q occur. Each $H^{n}(Rf_*E)$ has the finite filtration supplied by Step 1 whose graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,q}$ are subquotients of the coherent $E_2$-terms from Step 2. Coherent modules on the locally Noetherian scheme S are closed under kernels, cokernels, and finite extensions, so $H^{n}(Rf_*E)$ is coherent for every n.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof

proof.text: The bounded-below assertion is immediate from part 3 of [thm-sp-truncation-e2] used in Step 1: if $H^q(E)=0$ for $q<a$, every term of total degree $n<a$ vanishes, so $H^n(Rf_*E)=0$ for $n<a$.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof: 'Boundedness from below is trivial'

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-direct-image-qc-support-reduction] to replace X by a quasi-compact quasi-separated open X' containing the union of the supports, without changing Rf_*E. Since S is Noetherian and hence quasi-compact, [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-uniform-truncation-bound] supplies a uniform upper cohomological bound for the restricted direct image. Thus H^n(Rf_*E)=0 for all sufficiently large n, proving boundedness above.
